exposure: combined transvaginal and hysteroscopic electrocauterization of partial endometrium
cohort: 28 women with previous cesarean scar diverticulum
finding: While the combined transvaginal and hysteroscopic electrocauterization technique had a longer operation duration and hospital stay, it was associated with a significantly higher effective rate of  menstrual period improvement and scar diverticulum repair at 6 months follow-up compared to hysteroscopic electrocauterization alone.
